# Test fixtures

`reporter-v3.0.3-go1-report.html` is a real `report.html` written by
livingproof-capability-report v3.0.3 in CI run 41703287431 (verify on 8df8e90), artifact
`unitree-go1-playground-mujoco-hallway-capability-report-playground`.

- Original: 292535 bytes, sha256 `ee656f7cba835ddc5396f687c341bc43c221ec1945bb774153e4f9312cd83aed`
  (as listed in that artifact's `SHA256SUMS`).
- Fixture: the same bytes with only the `<details><summary>Full lossless report</summary>…</details>`
  block (the 285 kB lossless JSON) removed: 7308 bytes, sha256
  `cd6149a0b882d5c6b0749c880b3745750a365b2aa86aaaae9c33df1b8982d88f`.

Its Evidence section carries the reporter's `CI run` anchor and three download anchors.
The published pages must not keep those hrefs or that wording (lpv #23 and #48).

`repeats/` is the compared-repeat, seeded and single-trial bundles from
livingproof-capability-report v3.7.0 (`tests/fixtures/repeats` at tag `v3.7.0`,
commit `5f4114c2b78759a0ea4eb18584c0a232459ea90a`). `tests/test_repeat_report.py`
renders them with the reporter pinned in `verifications/settings.toml`.

`corner-evidence/v3.4.1/` holds the parts of two real evidence `manifest.json` files that the
parameters-digest check reads, from `livingproof-verification` verify run 44423756063 (head
ee40aa3, runner v3.4.1): `format`, `run_id`, `created`, `scenario` (from the embedded lock),
`environment.runner` and `sources` (absent: v3.4.1 predates livingproof-sim-mujoco#104). They
prove `tools/parameters_digest.py` refuses a run that records no digest.

`evaluator-result-run-integrity-pins.json` is generated by running
livingproof-evaluator-run `v1.5.1` (`dd60a9fbaeefce36310595a7730ea595911207f9`)
against the Go1 playground corner-left evidence fixture
(`livingproof-evaluator-run/tests/fixtures/pins/good`, CI verify run `44253837813`).
The result carries all five Run Integrity checks: completeness, pins, plan-conformance,
termination and recording. `recording` is not applicable (the Run Integrity job is given no
recordings and the plan declares no gap limit); it never has a default.

`corner-evidence/<definition>.json` (six files) are the same trimmed parts of the real evidence
`manifest.json` of each corner run in `livingproof-verification` verify run 44427325390 (head
797c1f9, runner v3.6.2), written by `tools/parameters_digest.py --fixture`. Each records
`sources.parameters`, which `tests/test_parameters_digest.py` compares with that definition's
original lock under `corner-evidence/locks/`. Those six lock snapshots are copied byte-for-byte
from commit `797c1f9958ef5f606afe026aa3aa74db5036d765` with
`git show <head>:verifications/<definition>.lock.json`; the historical manifests are unchanged.
Current locks are checked against fresh CI evidence by the verification workflow. Old G1
v3.6.2 evidence explicitly fails against the updated G1 v3.6.4 runner locks.
